en: I'd like you to carry out your current mission properly... Couldn't it wait until this mission is over?{wait}{clear}
Something urgent may come up. So, if you can, I'd rather you didn't go to the forest.{wait}{clear}
I understand...{wait}{clear}
This must worry you a great deal, Cecia. You may go to the forest.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, Angel. Then, the next time you visit, I'll be sure to ask you.{wait}{clear}
All right.{wait}{clear}
Angel... I am to undergo the rite of succession to become the Holy Mother.{wait}{clear}
What kind of rite is it?{wait}{clear}
It's... I will receive the Holy Mother's memories, the memories she holds as Holy Mother.{wait}{clear}
Inherit her memories?{wait}{clear}
Yes... that's right. I will inherit the memories of the Holy Mother... no, of Saint Diana herself.{wait}{clear}But...{wait}{clear}
Angel... I... I don't know what to do...{wait}{clear}
Cecia... I'm sorry, there's nothing I can tell you...{wait}{clear}All I can say is that I think it's best to follow your own heart.{wait}{clear}
If anything, I'm proud... I've been chosen by the Holy Mother, after all...{wait}{clear}
It's just so sudden... I don't know if I'm equal to it...{wait}{clear}
I understand your doubts.{n}
I'm sure you'll be fine.{n}
I understand why you're torn.{wait}{clear}But Cecia... please believe in yourself. There are things that only you... only you can do.{wait}{clear}
You'll be fine. I'm sure you'll make a wonderful Holy Mother, Cecia.{wait}{clear}I truly believe that.{wait}{clear}
......Thank you... Angel.{wait}{clear}
It's just... I'm afraid.{wait}{clear}
When I inherit the Holy Mother's memories...{wait}{clear}
will I still be able to be myself...?{wait}{clear}
Angel...{wait}{clear}
I love you, Angel...{wait}{clear}
If these feelings were to... slip away somewhere...{wait}{clear}
I...{wait}{clear}
I have a favor to ask...{wait}{clear}
One last time, while I'm still myself... I want you to...{wait}{clear}
Kiss Cecia{n}
Hold Cecia close{n}
Angel... thank you.{wait}{clear}
Now I think... I can make up my mind...{wait}{clear}
Close your eyes, and give your mind over to me.{wait}{clear}
Cecia, the color of your eyes...{wait}{clear}
This is the sign. The sign of one who has inherited Diana-sama's memories... the sign of the Holy Mother.{wait}{clear}I have received everything. All of Diana-sama's memories...{wait}{clear}
And those memories are...?{wait}{clear}
I'll tell you about them, little by little... Not yet, though...{wait}{clear}
Cecia...{wait}{clear}

Please don't worry.{wait}{clear}With the knowledge and power I've inherited from the Holy Mother, I'll do my best to restore order to this world.{wait}{clear}Angel, please, watch over me.{wait}{clear}
Angel... tomorrow I am to undergo the rite of succession to become the Holy Mother.{wait}{clear}
If these feelings were to... slip away somewhere...{wait}{clear}
What a huge lake this is.{wait}{clear}
Today it's called Lake Dreihaup. And a thousand years ago, it was where we fought the Heavenly Dragon.{wait}{clear}
Huh? Cecia... is that the Holy Mother's memory?{wait}{clear}

Yes... it's Diana's memory.{wait}{clear}A thousand years ago, the world fell into ever deeper chaos because of a Demon Stone the Crimson Moon King found on Mount Delphinia.{wait}{clear}With the power of the Demon Stone, the Crimson Moon King controlled the demons and killed people, making the stone's power grow stronger.{wait}{clear}In the end, he offered even himself to the Demon Stone, and the Heavenly Dragon appeared.{wait}{clear}The Heavenly Dragon laid waste to this world, and grew ever mightier, feeding on people's sorrow, pain and hatred.{wait}{clear}
The three of us fought that Heavenly Dragon. Guided by an archangel...{wait}{clear}
An archangel...{wait}{clear}

After a deadly struggle, the three of us defeated the Heavenly Dragon here. This lake was born from the dragon's corpse. And the Demon Stone, shattered into three, was left in our hands.{wait}{clear}The archangel told us to guard the Demon Stones, and returned to the Heavens.{wait}{clear}We each took one stone, and swore to protect them.{wait}{clear}Afterwards, one of us founded a nation as a saint, and one, sadly, was taken by darkness in a land far to the north...{wait}{clear}

And yet the Demon Stone has been stolen. If all three stones are brought together, the Heavenly Dragon will revive, and something terrible will happen...{wait}{clear}Back then, we fought desperately for the world and for its people. And we were entrusted with the Demon Stones.{wait}{clear}But now I can't understand the heart of the archangel who left the stones to us and wished for peace in the world...{wait}{clear}
Please don't be afraid.{n}
Let's do our best together.{n}

I can't know what the archangel who protected the surface world a thousand years ago was thinking.{wait}{clear}But I'm sure they entrusted humanity with hope and a future.{wait}{clear}Cecia... please, don't be afraid.{wait}{clear}Thank you, truly, for telling me about the battle a thousand years ago.{wait}{clear}You know what happened a thousand years ago, so you understand better than I do how grave things are now.{wait}{clear}But I'm sure there is still hope.{wait}{clear}
You're right... Angel. Diana-sama's memories are so vivid, I let them make me timid.{wait}{clear}I will get the Demon Stone back, I promise.{wait}{clear}

I can't know what the archangel who protected the surface world a thousand years ago was thinking.{wait}{clear}But I'm sure they entrusted humanity with hope and a future.{wait}{clear}So, Cecia, let's do our best together.{wait}{clear}You know what happened a thousand years ago, so you understand better than I do how grave things are now.{wait}{clear}But I'm sure there is still hope.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, truly, for telling me about the battle a thousand years ago.{wait}{clear}
Cecia, get some good rest, all right?{wait}{clear}
Thank you, Angel.{wait}{clear}
(Who could the archangel who protected Arcaya a thousand years ago have been...? I'll ask Lord Raphael...){wait}{clear}
Lord Raphael, are you there?{wait}{clear}
Raphael
Is that you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?{wait}{clear}
What is it? Is something troubling you in the world below?{wait}{clear}

Yes... Cecia, a hero of Arcaya, has inherited memories from a thousand years ago through a certain rite.{wait}{clear}She told me about the battle of a thousand years ago and about the Heavenly Dragon.{wait}{clear}She said the heroes who fought then were guarded by an archangel.{wait}{clear}If I could speak with the archangel who protected Arcaya, I think I could help Arcaya's heroes far more than I do now...{wait}{clear}Lord Raphael, do you know who the archangel who protected Arcaya was?{wait}{clear}
......{wait}{clear}I see... So Diana went as far as gaining such a power to pass the memory of that battle on to later ages.{wait}{clear}
Lord Raphael... it can't be...?{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, I'm sorry I kept silent. It was I who protected Arcaya a thousand years ago.{wait}{clear}
When you ordered me to protect Arcaya, why didn't you tell me anything?!{wait}{clear}
I meant to tell you when the time was right. Now, I suppose that sounds like nothing but a convenient excuse...{wait}{clear}I never imagined it would come to this...{wait}{clear}
Lord Raphael...{wait}{clear}

It is true that I protected Arcaya and guided them. They defeated the Heavenly Dragon with their own hands, and I entrusted the future to them and to all the people of Arcaya...{wait}{clear}We angels are by no means all-powerful. The world below belongs to humans, first and last. It is not a world we angels should rightly meddle in.{wait}{clear}
But leaving the Demon Stones with them...{wait}{clear}
Yes, I understand how you feel. I agonized over it too, over whether I should simply leave the surface world...{wait}{clear}But we cannot so much as touch those stones.{wait}{clear}
Michael
You have learned that firsthand...{wait}{clear}
But Lord Raphael, to leave something so dangerous in the world below!{wait}{clear}

That is why I entrusted the Demon Stones to heroes with righteous hearts. There was no other way...{wait}{clear}Diana knew how I felt, and surely...{wait}{clear}But if someone means to misuse the Demon Stones, it is very dangerous. It may even be one of the fallen angels...{wait}{clear}
Someone is certainly gathering the Demon Stones. But whether a fallen angel is behind it, I can't tell yet... I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}

No, there is no need to apologize. As you say, if the Demon Stones are being gathered, what we must fear is the Heavenly Dragon's revival.{wait}{clear}It seems all we can do is ask you to work with the heroes to stop it somehow.{wait}{clear}This has become a hard mission for you, hasn't it...{wait}{clear}

No, I'm not the one having a hard time. The heroes who fight almost every day have it much harder.{wait}{clear}For their sake too, I'll do my very best to stop the Heavenly Dragon from reviving.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. The fallen angels move as quietly as the night and as swiftly as thieves...{wait}{clear}Be careful, you and the heroes alike.{wait}{clear}
